name: Awkward Bill Arrival
trigger: The check lands before anyone has discussed who invited whom.
effect_text: On a failed save, each target either pays too much or gains Doubt until the scene ends.

name: Bad Music With Excellent Confidence
trigger: The playlist switches to something aggressively wrong for the room.
effect_text: Creatures relying on charm or subtlety take -2 on CHA checks until someone changes the playlist.

name: Whiteboard Fumes
trigger: A dry-erase marker is uncapped with the reverence of a holy relic.
effect_text: Targets in the same zone become Distracted; tech or presentation checks suffer if nobody opens a window.

name: Service Queue With Opinions
trigger: The line notices the conflict and begins silently judging every choice.
effect_text: Failure adds Heat +1 or Embarrassed until the party protects the staff or moves the scene.

name: Dying Laptop Battery
trigger: A device drops below 5 percent while the objective still depends on it.
effect_text: On failure, the acting character gains Panic and tech-based checks take -2 until recharged.

name: Outlet Turf War
trigger: Two or more parties reach for the same outlet or power strip.
effect_text: Failure knocks a charger loose, applies Power Loss, or forces a Social Grapple over socket rights.

name: Icebreaker Round That Should Be Illegal
trigger: A facilitator asks everyone to share a fun fact and a vulnerability.
effect_text: Failure applies Uncomfortable; a natural 1 creates a public callback the GM may weaponize later.

name: Group Chat Receipts Leak
trigger: Someone posts screenshots before context can put on shoes.
effect_text: Failure creates Receipts Collected against the target and advances the complication clock.

name: Algorithmic Spotlight
trigger: The platform decides this is the exact wrong moment to go viral.
effect_text: Targets become Cannot Be Ignored; all subtle actions are at disadvantage until attention moves.

name: Visa Printer Jam
trigger: The final document is ready except the printer has entered its villain era.
effect_text: Failure costs one clock segment and gives the Embassy Official advantage on Delay You Politely.

name: Security Bag Check With Commentary
trigger: Security asks why anyone needs this many adapters.
effect_text: Failure costs Access -1 or exposes one embarrassing item as leverage.

name: Ring Light Overheat
trigger: The lighting rig gets hotter than the discourse.
effect_text: Failure blinds nearby creatures for 1 round and makes the next photo-based action risky.

name: Brunch Split-Bill Math
trigger: The table discovers that shared appetizers are a constitutional crisis.
effect_text: Failure applies Doubt and costs Social Capital unless someone imposes a fair split.

name: Free Trial Expiry
trigger: The software trial expires exactly when the demo needs to work.
effect_text: Failure shuts down one tool and applies Panic to the presenter.

name: Pitch Deck Version Conflict
trigger: Nobody is presenting the same file.
effect_text: Failure adds Distracted and causes one fact in the pitch to become Misinformation.

name: Wellness Gong Resonance
trigger: A gong is struck with the confidence of a person who owns linen pants.
effect_text: Failure applies Bored or Stunned for 1 round if the target was already Bored.

name: Mandatory Sharing Circle
trigger: The facilitator says attendance is optional in a way that means compulsory.
effect_text: Failure applies Social Grapple and prevents leaving the zone without an escape contest.

name: Night Market Bottleneck
trigger: A crowd, scooter, influencer tripod, and auntie cart all occupy one destiny.
effect_text: Failure makes movement cost double and gives Slow Walkers or Queue Skippers tactical cover.

name: Karaoke Feedback Scream
trigger: A microphone decides to settle every argument by volume.
effect_text: Failure deals sonic damage and Silences the next verbal action.

name: Founder Time Dilation
trigger: A founder says 'quick context' and time collapses inward.
effect_text: Failure costs one clock segment and applies Bored; casters must check Concentration.

name: Demo WiFi Collapse
trigger: The network vanishes the moment a stakeholder leans forward.
effect_text: Failure applies Power Loss and advances the failure clock unless a hotspot or favor is spent.

name: Camera Flash Mob
trigger: A dozen strangers begin recording vertically at once.
effect_text: Failure applies Blinded or Embarrassed and makes the next failure public.

name: Airport Gate Change Prophecy
trigger: The gate changes after everyone has sat down and emotionally committed.
effect_text: Failure applies Panic and moves all zones one step farther from the objective.

name: Fake Calendar Invite
trigger: A malicious calendar invite claims the real meeting is elsewhere.
effect_text: Failure sends one PC to the wrong zone or gives an enemy a surprise round.
